Hi Emma / Clyde —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the context on the search-relevance use case and the throughput targets you shared. Quick recap and proposed next steps so the team has one place to refer to: 

- Scope: evaluate Redwood inference for re-ranking ~50 queries/min with 512-token context, measure P99 latency and per-token cost.
- Success criteria: match or exceed your current relevance by targeted eval set, and demonstrate predictable 250ms P95 on our dedicated config.
- Proposed POC timeline: 2 weeks of active testing (sandbox data) + optional integration week.

Action items (owner / due):
1) Skyloft: confirm the two datasets you want pushed into the sandbox (Emma) — due May 7
2) Redwood: provision sandbox instance, share SSO link and runbook (Olga) — provisioning planned by May 6
3) Both: schedule a short kickoff to validate connectivity and auth (15–30m) — proposed May 11 or 12

I've attached a POC-runbook.pdf that walks through the steps we typically follow, and an SSO-setup-guide.md with the IdP hints. Also attaching a first-pass SOW-draft_v1.docx for your procurement team to look at (pricing placeholders included).

If May 11 works for you, I can block a 30-minute slot and bring Marissa (SE) for a short walkthrough. If your priorities shifted, no problem — just let us know a better window and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Olga Petrov
